title: Everest Job
description: A MERN job portal connecting candidates and companies.
longDescription: Companies can post jobs and update application statuses. Candidates can apply with a CV and receive email notifications. Redux manages client-side state.

title: Realtime Chat
description: A real-time messaging application built with the MERN stack.
longDescription: User registration and instant messaging powered by Socket.IO, with a React frontend styled using Tailwind CSS and daisyUI.

title: Food Ordering System
description: Go Food — a food ordering application built with the MERN stack.
longDescription: A React frontend styled with Bootstrap, connected to a Node.js and Express backend with MongoDB persistence.

title: Hotel Booking System
longDescription: A hotel booking system built with React, Express, and MongoDB.
